states.claim: When ent1->varname is PHP_CLASS_NAME_VAR, ent1->data is a non-empty string, and ent2 is an ST_STRUCT array, pce is looked up or set to PHP_IC_ENTRY, obj is initialized as an object of pce, ent2->data is destroyed and replaced by obj, and ent1->data is destroyed.
When ent2->data is an object, ent1->data is added as a property named ent1->varname to ent2->data, and ent1->data's refcount is decremented if refcounted.
When ent2->data is neither the special struct case nor an object, ent1->data is inserted into target_hash under ent1->varname.
When ent1->varname is NULL, ent1->data is inserted into target_hash at the next index.
ent1->varname is freed and ent1 is freed after processing.
When stack->top is not greater than 1, stack->done is set to 1.
When name is EL_VAR and stack->varname is non-NULL, stack->varname is freed and set to NULL.
When name is EL_FIELD, ent is set to the top stack entry, ent is freed, and stack->top is decremented.
